SELECT count(*) AS lines, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS dist_line_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS dist_receipt_line,
 min(sale_date) AS mn, max(sale_date) AS mx, max(etl_loaded_at) AS last_load,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.web_order_id IS NULL THEN f.receipt_id END) AS lines_no_order,
 sum(CASE WHEN o.status NOT IN ('delivered','collected') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lines_undispatched,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.channel_code='WB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wb_lines,
 sum(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date>=DATE '2025-10-25'

WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2025-11-03' AS start_date, DATE '2026-10-04' AS end_date),
web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
  SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, p.sku, f.net_amount AS sold_net, 0 AS refunded_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, 0, r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.brand,
       ROUND(SUM(n.sold_net),2) AS sold_net, ROUND(SUM(n.refunded_net),2) AS refunded, ROUND(SUM(n.sold_net-n.refunded_net),2) AS web_net_sales,
       ROUND(SUM(n.sold_net),2) AS x
FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
ORDER BY web_net_sales DESC
LIMIT 14

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
mine AS (
  SELECT SUM(x) AS total FROM (
    SELECT f.net_amount AS x FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
      JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
      WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND w.dispatch_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-03' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
      WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-03' AND DATE '2026-10-04') t
),
ctl AS (SELECT SUM(net_sales) AS total FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=900 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-03' AND DATE '2026-10-04'),
webret_elsewhere AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS n, SUM(r.refund_net) AS amt FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store sf ON sf.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_store sr ON sr.store_key=r.store_key
  WHERE sf.store_id=900 AND sr.store_id<>900 AND r.return_date>=DATE '2025-11-03'),
dupsku AS (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM (SELECT sku FROM dim_product WHERE is_current GROUP BY sku HAVING count(*)>1))
SELECT mine.total AS mine, ctl.total AS control, webret_elsewhere.n AS web_returns_elsewhere, webret_elsewhere.amt, dupsku.n AS skus_multi_current
FROM mine, ctl, webret_elsewhere, dupsku

  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (

    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND w.dispatch_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-03' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.sku, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store sr ON sr.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store sf ON sf.store_key=f.store_key
    WHERE sr.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-03' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.sku, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store sr ON sr.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store sf ON sf.store_key=f.store_key
    WHERE sf.store_id=900 AND sr.store_id<>900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-03' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
)
SELECT sku, ROUND(SUM(v),2) AS net_follow_line FROM net_lines GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 12

WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2025-11-03' AS start_date, DATE '2026-10-04' AS end_date),
web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
  SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, SUM(n.net_sales) AS web_net_sales
FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
GROUP BY cp.sku, cp.product_name
ORDER BY web_net_sales DESC
LIMIT 10
